schema.description:
The enriched, read-time view of a `GIFT_LIST` post. Draw secrecy:
`myRecipient` is the only pairing any response ever carries.

managerId.description: The starter, who manages participants, settings and the draw.

itemCount.description: Wishes on their own wishlist (not those of guests they manage).

guests.description:
Wishlists for people without an account, each kept up by one
participant (`managedById`). Never part of the draw. Missing on
servers without the `giftListGuests` feature.

exclusions.description: Pairs that may not draw each other — only returned to the starter (`null` for everyone else).

myRecipient.description: Who you're buying for, once the names are drawn.

schema.title: PostGiftList
